about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the world of SPARTA 2035 with an engaging soundtrack that highlights the tension and dynamics of the game. The soundtracks are designed to convey the atmosphere of vibrant African locations where thrilling battles against intelligent opponents unfold. Each composition is filled with energy, reflecting the strategic moments of tactical combat, intense clashes, and the true struggle for justice.

The soundtrack includes musical themes that accompany various stages of the game—from tutorials and coordinated actions to tense battles in residential streets and military bases. The melodies range from energetic rhythms during fights to more melancholic notes during character interactions and plot twists.

The soundtracks are located in the game folder.
